notes: Transportation is now optimized as a date-first traveler screen. After a travel date is selected, all registered transportation for that date is grouped immediately near the selector, while receipts, protocols, filters, the full trip register and unrelated rail days move out of the way. The traveler can open only the selected day's full rail route/maps or detailed/secure records when needed, and can return to the full Transportation app through Other transportation tools. Oct. 6 still groups both the Zurich HB-to-airport train and Zurich-to-Istanbul flight. Transportation nested offline cache was refreshed.
name: TEE v3.5.27 — Compact Transportation Date Focus
